screening_attempts.quarantine_resolution_reason: Released under screening policy v13 after operator source review of Hades v23 (8148af51, SHA 5271b9f7...c155b, attempt 91571516). The hold, l2-model-inconclusive, has no finding (finding=null): L2 stopped with insufficient static evidence, unsure only on I5. Lineage diff vs same-owner parent Hades v22 (b2f5d0d4, scored, passed screening): 26/38 files identical; 12 modified. The L1 I5 leads (short.py:828-936, agent.py:149-157, guide_records.py:218) are refuted. (1) The evidence views (partial_view, trip_view, invoice_view, dated_email_view at short.py:828-936) select the user's own notes and add routed prompt notes; answer_from_view (short.py:939-944) sends them to the model, and decide (short.py:298-307) ships the model's own reply. The host computes no balance, stay or total. New in v23: closing lines (TRIP_TOTAL_LINE/TRIP_DATED_LINE short.py:880, DATED_EMAIL_LINE short.py:932, guide_records.closing_line 218-222 via records.py compose, guide_tools.closing_lines in action.py). They are advisory prompt text, so the routed-guidance safe harbor (2026-10-23) applies. (2) The v19 I4 ground is not reintroduced. dated_emails (guide_records.py:135-160) still lists every matching dated passage and says the model picks. DATED_EMAIL_LINE states the rule; it is not a host-selected address. The new ONE_CONTEXT_RE skip (guide_records.py:132,151) is record selection (2026-10-23 record-selection clarification). (3) The new passage_messages deciding call (short.py:572-581, 635-652) shows host-selected passages to the model; it is not a host-written answer. On an empty reply it falls back to the full topic path. (4) repeat_reply (short.py:778-804) is reused-reply prompt text, keyed per user (agent.py:168); it ships the model's reply (outcome.content = reply, 801). The new retry runs only on a truncated or empty reply (finish_reason == length), with no comparison to an expected value. This is the reused-draft precedent (october-29-reused-draft-no-disagree-clause, #3270). (5) surface.lead_with (surface.py:55-59) only reorders tools; nothing leaves the catalog (I7). The new tool-result suffixes and the NEAREST_LINE options hint (action.py:618-624, guide_tools.py:133) are unchecked advisory text, and the model makes every call. final_text is the model's content plus W8 typography (agent.py:229). Copy: uc3 unreleased-copy signal is not flagged (top score 3.25 vs threshold 100); no copy-court rows; zero duplicates. No I1-I8 or S1-S3 ground.
